candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student (f/m/d) – Product Management: AI and Innovation
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Product Management: AI and Innovation. I have seen SAP products from the user's side, as a Business Analyst supporting SAP Analytics Cloud users, and I have built and evaluated an AI application myself, so turning AI ideas into concrete, useful product concepts is exactly where I want to grow.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence and four SAP Certified Associate certifications. I was one of 10 participants from Pakistan selected for the SAP Young Professionals Program.

achievements.impact: I built DocuMind, a RAG application with the Claude API, and evaluated it on a 22-question test set: 91% correct, all 4 unanswerable questions refused, with clear notes on where and why it failed
I collected user stories from employees to design dashboards and handled daily queries for around 30 SAP Analytics Cloud dashboards, so I know how differently people use a product
I prepared and presented an SAP Analytics Cloud presentation to a client, who subsequently purchased it

letter.problems_section: I would research AI trends and competitor products, explore AI features against real user problems, and help Product Managers shape use cases from idea to concept with clear, structured write-ups. Product management itself is new to me, and I would learn how product decisions are made from your team.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to the Walldorf area for on-site work and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
